hero.title: One balance for courses and AI strategies.
hero.subtitle: Load a Usage Balance once and use it across Cur Nova: structured PDF courses, custom courses and AI-generated strategies. Or pay directly for a single course if you prefer.

bullets.oneBalance: One balance for Forex, Crypto and Binary content.
bullets.payWithTokens: Pay with Usage Units or direct in EUR, GBP or USD.
bullets.topUpAnytime: Top up any time – Usage Units do not expire.

exampleRate.title: Example effective rate
exampleRate.subtitle: For visual purposes only
exampleRate.description: In production, Usage Unit pricing will be defined per region and currency. Here we simply show how packs and custom top-ups could work inside the interface.
exampleRate.example: For example: <tokens>{tokens}</tokens> might correspond to approximately <price>{price}</price> (or regional equivalent), but final values will be defined in legal terms and payment settings.

tokenPacks.title: Usage Unit Packages.
tokenPacks.subtitle: Start small or commit for longer – each pack loads Usage Units into your Cur Nova balance for use across courses and AI.
tokenPacks.note: Currency shown here is illustrative. Final pricing may differ.
tokenPacks.info: Exact Usage Unit conversion will be defined in production.

customTopUp.title: Custom top-up
customTopUp.subtitle: Set any amount in your preferred currency. In production, the system converts it to Usage Units automatically.
customTopUp.minAmount: Minimum 0.01 in any supported currency. No formal maximum – larger top-ups are simply converted into more Usage Units.

directPayment.title: Pay directly for a single course
directPayment.subtitle: If you prefer not to manage a balance, you can pay for individual courses or custom PDFs directly in your currency.

bullets.currencies: Use EUR, GBP or USD depending on your region.
bullets.noTokens: Usage Units are not required – direct payment simply unlocks that specific product.
bullets.convertLater: In future, you can always convert to a usage-based workflow if you prefer.

howTokensWork.title: How Usage Units work inside Cur Nova.
howTokensWork.subtitle: A simple balance that powers both structured courses and AI-based tools.

step1.title: Add Usage Units
step1.description: Buy a pack or set a custom top-up using your preferred currency.

step2.title: Use Usage Units on content
step2.description: Spend Usage Units on ready-made courses, custom PDFs and AI strategies.

step3.title: Track in your dashboard
step3.description: See balance, usage and history – including which products used how many Usage Units.

step4.title: Top up when needed
step4.description: Usage Units do not expire, so you can top up at your own pace when the balance gets low.

riskNotice.title: Important risk and Usage Unit notice.
riskNotice.paragraph1: Trading Forex, Crypto and Binary options is highly speculative and can lead to substantial or total loss of capital. Usage Units, courses and AI outputs on Cur Nova are for educational purposes only. They do not contain financial advice or trading signals.
riskNotice.paragraph2: Usage Units themselves are a way to access digital educational content inside Cur Nova. They are not a separate financial product or investment. Usage Unit pricing, refund rules and any region-specific limitations will be defined in the final Terms & Conditions and Risk & Disclaimer.
